changeSet.author: liquibase

preConditions.onFailMessage: Existing payment_pay_date_flow_id_idx has an unexpected definition or is not valid and ready.
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_class idx JOIN pg_namespace ns ON ns.oid = idx.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_index ix ON ix.indexrelid = idx.oid LEFT JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = idx.relam WHERE ns.nspname = 'fdr3' AND idx.relname = 'payment_pay_date_flow_id_idx' AND NOT COALESCE( idx.relkind = 'i' AND am.amname = 'btree' AND ix.indrelid = 'fdr3.payment'::regclass AND ix.indisvalid AND ix.indisready AND NOT ix.indisunique AND ix.indnatts = 2 AND ix.indnkeyatts = 2 AND ix.indpred IS NULL AND ix.indexprs IS NULL AND ix.indoption::text = '0 0' AND pg_get_indexdef(idx.oid, 1, true) = 'pay_date' AND pg_get_indexdef(idx.oid, 2, true) = 'flow_id', FALSE )

changeSet.comment: Support daily recovery discovery without scanning the full payment history. Preserve an existing matching index.
